answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 151239 Country: India Title: Education loan Question: With due respect I want to ask you that I want to study abroad for my higher study just now my father is not in a condition to pay for me so should I can take loan from bank or not? Answer ID: 151239 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1046/985/M=8/1438) In case of taking loan from bank one has to pay interest, whereas the hadith curses those who take interest or give it. Hence one should avoid taking interest based loan for higher education. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
